status: Proposed configurable policy; not a validated psychometric model.

mastery.unit: skill_id × assessed modality; keep a separate profile for listening, speaking, reading and writing
mastery.modality_definition: The assessed construct, not merely the response medium: a typed answer to previously unseen audio can demonstrate listening comprehension if no transcript was seen. Log input and response modalities separately.

bands.meaning: Little demonstrated control; may recognise a model but cannot reliably retrieve or apply it.
Emerging understanding; succeeds mainly with cues, slow input or worked examples.
Can handle familiar controlled tasks; performance is inconsistent on changed input.
Increasingly independent and reliable within the defined skill and task scope; some support or review remains.
Repeated independent success, retained after delay and transferred across inputs or contexts; not global fluency.

mastery.untested: Store null and status=unknown, not a numerical failure. A learner-facing 0 may mean no evidence only if explicitly labelled.

dimension_meanings.understanding: Explain meaning, contrast or error; English or another familiar explanation language is acceptable.
dimension_meanings.recall: Retrieve meaning or a form without seeing the answer; recognition and production are tagged separately.
dimension_meanings.practical_performance: Perform the actual listening, speaking, reading, writing or study-method task under logged conditions.
dimension_meanings.transfer_assessment: Use the skill on fresh input or a changed communicative task; not another viewing of the same model.

eligible_evidence: Score only the explicitly targeted skill and observed modality; do not propagate one score to every prerequisite.

A general grammar explanation supports conceptual understanding only. A modality-specific understanding event needs relevant input or production evidence; never relabel a text-only grammar check as listening performance.
Deduplicate the same attempt and prompt. Repetition is practice but not a new independent transfer task.
Answer-seen attempts can document corrected understanding, not independent recall or transfer.
Transcript-seen input is reading-assisted listening, not unaided listening.
Teacher/competent-listener observation can establish speaking evidence; text-only chat cannot establish pronunciation.
AI ratings remain provisional where uncertainty is material; retain rater identity and confidence.

Written Arabic application checks remain text-based even when their parent lesson concerns listening or speaking. Do not let the parent lesson label upgrade their modality. Open-ended sample answers are exemplars, not exact-match answer sets.
scoring_algorithm: For each skill × modality × dimension, keep the latest three eligible, distinct scored attempts in the rolling evidence window. Include low scores; do not cherry-pick successful attempts.
Multiply each raw rubric score by its support_credit. For recent, next and third attempts use weights 0.5, 0.3 and 0.2; renormalise if fewer exist.
Multiply dimension means by 0.15, 0.20, 0.45 and 0.20 and sum. An unobserved dimension contributes zero to this conservative estimate and remains visibly unknown.
If every dimension is unobserved, return null. Apply all relevant evidence caps below.
For a skill requiring several modalities, its prerequisite score is the minimum current readiness among those modalities; unknown blocks an independent mastery claim.
Show historical demonstrated score, current readiness estimate, confidence and review-due status separately.

caps.condition: Independent successful practice appears on fewer than two calendar dates
No successful delayed transfer at least seven days after initial successful independent practice
Any condition in score_above_80_requires is missing
Evidence does not cover every required modality
caps.note: Unknown required modality additionally prevents an independent prerequisite pass.

score_above_80_requires.input_variation: At least two texts, voices, prompts or contexts appropriate to the skill.
score_above_80_requires.speaking_review: Competent listener or qualified teacher evidence for pronunciation-sensitive claims; ASR alone is insufficient.

freshness.last_practice_definition: Latest eligible independent recall, practical or transfer event; reading a lesson does not refresh the date.
freshness.stable_definition: Meets the above-80 evidence conditions, not merely a high immediate quiz score.
freshness.readiness_formula: max(0, historical_score - min(15, 10 * max(0, days_since_practice - window_days) / window_days))
freshness.review_due: days_since_practice > window_days; show as an estimate rather than a measured amount forgotten.
freshness.independent_progression: Require current score >=70 plus an eligible event within 60 days; otherwise offer a short refresh check.
freshness.supported_progression: Learner may preview or attempt scaffolded work below the gate; do not label prerequisites mastered.
freshness.new_success: Refresh that skill/modality using actual evidence; never reset all skills because one was practised.

retention_state_rules.new: An observed score below 41, or no independent practical success yet. Unknown stays unknown.
retention_state_rules.developing: Observed performance that is not new and does not meet the stable evidence conditions.
retention_state_rules.stable: Meets every score_above_80_requires condition for this skill and modality.

freshness.empty_rolling_window: If no eligible attempts remain in the 365-day scoring window, current estimate is null/unknown and review is due. Preserve the last dated historical snapshot; do not convert an expired window into a measured zero or silently reuse it as current evidence.
freshness.historical_snapshot: Store each dated estimate with its policy version. Historical score means the last demonstrated estimate at that date, not a cherry-picked all-time maximum.

confidence.low: Single prompt, one day, self-rating only, or uncertain automated feedback.
confidence.medium: Several independent attempts with some input variation and consistent rubric judgements.
confidence.high: Repeated delayed transfer with suitable variety and credible external feedback where needed.

mastery.level_reporting: Never map 80 mastery points to CEFR B2 or issue CEFR/ACTFL/ILR certification. Report scope, modality and evidence.

placement: Ask about prior script learning, MSA exposure, dialect experience and recitation separately.
Use brief fresh tasks for decoding, comprehension, listening, speaking and writing; stop before exhaustion.
Skip instruction only for demonstrated skills; retain delayed checks. Prior dialect knowledge can help but is not automatic MSA mastery.
Do not require whole-module repetition when only one prerequisite skill is weak.
candidate_selection: Read the chosen path and explicit skill dependencies from the static package.
Prioritise a blocking weak prerequisite, a due review or an eligible new lesson; explain the reason.
Keep receptive and productive work represented across the week; use goals to weight them transparently.
Choose a single achievable main task for a low-energy day and record partial completion.
If audio or a partner is unavailable, choose another available modality and leave the missing modality untested.

weekly_balance.interpretation: Starting design heuristic across a week, not rigid daily quotas. Early script learning and individual needs may shift the balance; review can occur within any strand.

adaptation.revision_rule: Suggested starting schedule after success. Shorten after genuine retrieval difficulty, lengthen after retained independent success; do not flood the learner with overdue cards.

new_vocabulary_guidance.reduce_if: Review burden or delayed productive recall deteriorates. Zero new items is a valid review day.
new_vocabulary_guidance.unit: A useful lemma/sense or phrase in context; not every inflected surface form as a new word.

struggle_response: Diagnose whether the issue is sound, script, vocabulary, sentence meaning, grammar, recall or task load.
Reduce text length or number of new items; add one worked contrast or useful vowel mark.
Change explanation or sensory route, practise a smaller meaningful unit, then retry a new example.
After two supported failures, revisit the specific prerequisite and postpone the full challenge.
If listening is difficult, distinguish sound segmentation, unfamiliar vocabulary, syntax and processing load before adding grammar drills; use a new short recording for the recheck.

support_fading.transliteration: Optional temporary pronunciation cue; fade as script recognition develops. Never make transliteration the primary long-term reading channel.
support_fading.vowels: Full or targeted lexical vowels early; then selective disambiguation; then ordinary unvowelled prose. Keep meaningful distinctions and restore support locally when needed.
support_fading.translation: Attempt meaning first when accessible; show a gloss to resolve a block; return to Arabic on a fresh example.
support_fading.audio: Practise with pausing and slower speed if needed; record conditions and return gradually to suitable natural speech.

speech_feedback: Prioritise meaning-bearing contrasts, vowel/consonant length and intelligibility.
Do not rank cultural accents or require imitation of one nationality.
Use ASR as an optional clue; do not treat its transcript or confidence as a validated pronunciation score.
Declare pausal versus fully inflected reading before assessing endings.
If a synthetic voice is used, verify the exact MSA output and label it; flawed TTS must not become the gold standard.
adaptation.long_break: Begin with small fresh samples of important skills; preserve history and rebuild only the demonstrated gaps.
adaptation.accessibility: Allow larger Arabic text, spacing, high-contrast display, short blocks, typed or handwritten input and alternative input methods. Explain when an accommodation changes the assessed construct.

learner_data_model.privacy: Private by default. Ask before recording another person or publishing a portfolio; allow export and deletion. Avoid uploading voice to a provider without informed consent.

input: Available audio, partner and accessibility support
constraints: Return only IDs present in the current package.
Do not rewrite the static prerequisite graph silently.
Log policy version and material support changes.
Validate model output before applying state changes.
Preserve additive question IDs and attempt versions. A new question in curriculum 1.1.0 must not retroactively turn an earlier completed lesson into a failure.
implementation_contract.answer_keys: Serve answer keys after submission or to an authorised tutor. Keeping keys in another file does not secure them if both files are shipped publicly.
implementation_contract.rtl: Store logical Unicode text in NFC; use lang=ar and dir=rtl on Arabic runs. Isolate embedded Latin text and numbers appropriately.
implementation_contract.normalisation: For ordinary unvowelled-text comparisons, ignore only declared optional vowel marks. Do not silently merge ة/ه, ى/ي or hamza variants. Preserve verified Qur’anic source text unchanged.
implementation_contract.assessment: Never infer audible skills from text output. Keep independent first attempts, corrections and generated help distinguishable.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Reads every lesson without a task
acceptance_scenarios.expected: No mastery increase from page views.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Can recite but does not understand a fresh sentence
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Credit observed decoding/recitation only; comprehension remains unproven.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Types flawless answers without an audio sample
acceptance_scenarios.expected: No pronunciation or listening mastery awarded.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Uses a visible transcript to understand a clip
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Store assisted evidence; request a fresh audio-only attempt later.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Knows the alphabet and passes a new-word diagnostic
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Skip mastered script instruction, retain relevant delayed checks.
Caps and low confidence prevent a stable mastery claim.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Has only 10 minutes and low energy
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Assign one small review/practice unit; record partial completion.

acceptance_scenarios.case: No recording or competent speaker available
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Choose another modality; keep listening unknown.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Reads well but cannot answer spoken questions
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Maintain separate reading and listening/speaking scores.

acceptance_scenarios.case: After 100 days, learner opens an old lesson
acceptance_scenarios.expected: No date refresh from opening; offer a fresh check without erasing past evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Strong delayed transfer on different prompts and dates
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Allow score above 80 only when the defined evidence conditions are met.

acceptance_scenarios.case: A learner wants only the technology branch after B1
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Use the closed technology path, not every B2 specialist module.
Replace the input provider, preserve outcome, register and assessment conditions.
Do not treat ASR acceptance as conclusive pronunciation evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.case: A model produces a skill ID not in the package
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Reject the assignment and regenerate or use a deterministic valid fallback.

acceptance_scenarios.case: Answers a written Arabic application question attached to a listening lesson
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Credit only the observed written/conceptual evidence, leaving audio comprehension untested.

acceptance_scenarios.case: An older lesson gains an additive question in a new curriculum version
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Preserve the earlier completion and evidence; offer the additional check for the next relevant review.

calibration.pilot: Compare a sample of automated judgements with qualified Arabic teachers and learner outcomes.
monitor: performance by modality and support level
calibration.change_management: Version thresholds and heuristics separately from the curriculum; retain prior evidence and explain changed estimates.
